content: Desde 2026-03-23 a imagem localstack/localstack exige LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN (Community encerrada, imagem unificada). Plano Hobby gratuito (nao comercial) inclui EC2 CRUD (VPC/subnet/SG), IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, S3, KMS; ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, ECR e ELB/ELBv2 so a partir do plano Base (pago), conforme badges 'Included in Plans' em docs.localstack.cloud/aws/services/*.
